content:
frank (reliability): Publishing the Private/Onprem Regional Failover & DR Playbook (v1) today. TL;DR: documented failover modes (active-active, active-passive), recommended RPO/RTO targets per tier, and a runbook for customer-led failovers. Docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/onprem-dr-playbook-v1 — please review if you own CSM/CS/ONP installs.

lauren (product): Great. Main ask from PM: highlight which features require agent v>=3.3 (KV cache replay, checkpoint sync). We should call out incompatibilities.

omar (eng): Noted. Quick tech bits: checkpoint sync requires agent 3.3+ with `checkpoint_sync: enabled` and a shared object store (S3/GCS compatible). Active-active requires sequence-numbered KV logs with monotonic ordering.

kelly (legal): Flag: DR procedures may move data across borders during failover. Add a customer opt-in checkbox and a suggested contract clause for cross-region failovers. See sample clause in appendix C.

dr-bot: Scheduled doc publish: onprem-dr-playbook-v1 -> staging (CI #5012). ETA 2h. :page_with_curl:

gina (support): For customers: can we include a minimal checklist for non-managed installs? They want simple steps to perform manual failover with minimal commands.

frank (reliability): Yes — included. Minimal manual failover snippet (for onprem agent):

```bash
# switch tenant routing to fallback region
redwood-ctl tenant-set --tenant acme --primary-region eu-west-1 --failover-region eu-central-1 --force
# replay KV cache snapshot
redwood-agent replay-snapshot --tenant acme --snapshot /var/backups/acme-kv-snap.tar.gz
# healthcheck
redwood-ctl healthcheck --tenant acme
```

lauren (product): Also added recommended SLAs per tier: Tier 1 = RTO 15m / RPO 0-5m (requires Dedicated + checkpoint sync), Tier 2 = RTO 1h / RPO up to 1h (onprem managed), Tier 3 = RTO 24h / RPO 24h (self-managed). Make sure sales & CSMs can quickly map customer needs.

carlos (sales): Need a onepager and a risk matrix for presales; customers ask about cost of replication + egress. Include example pricing impacts for active-active vs passive.

frank (reliability): Action items: @omar add exact agent flags + compatibility table; @kelly draft contract opt-in clause for cross-region failover; @gina create CSM one-pager and manual checklist; @lauren add pricing notes with finance. Tracker: https://internal.redwood/tracker/DR-01.

omar (eng): Will add agent compatibility table and a small config example for checkpoint sync: 

```yaml
replication:
  mode: "checkpoint_sync"
  object_store: "s3://acme-dr-bucket"
  frequency: "5m"
  retention: "7d"
agent:
  version: "3.3.0+"
  checkpoint_sync: true
```

kelly (legal): I'll work with sales ops on the opt-in language and post the suggested amendment by EOD tomorrow.

gina (support): I'll draft the CSM one-pager and add sample support SLAs and a contact playbook for failover incidents.

frank (reliability): Thanks. Please update the tracker when items done. We'll bake this into the onboarding checklist for new Private customers next release cycle. Close comments here unless blocking issues. :white_check_mark:
